title: Brandon Tuned It Tight
style: 124 bpm, bass house, four-on-the-floor kick, swung 16th hats, rolling bassline, beatbox vocal stack, sidechain pumping, male rap with female lead, dual beatbox layers, club mix, late-night grit, controlled euphoria
lyrics:
[Intro - dual beatbox, ping-pong stereo]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm

[Build - Male Rap, low and tight]
Brandon tuned the engines, every bolt in place
No loose wire, no drop in the bass
The Pelican breathes, the Pelican hums
When Brandon's in the room, the engine becomes

[Pre-Drop - Babble Bots]
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — brandon tuned it tight

[Drop - Male Rap + Fem Lead]
Brandon tuned it tight — every line dialed in

Brandon tuned it tight — no machine between us
Just a man and a wrench and a boat that frees us

[Verse 2 - Fem Lead, melodic]
My brother's partner, the engineer's hand
Brandon on the engines, the family's strand
Pete on the helm and Brandon on the floor
The Pelican runs because they keep the score

[Bridge - Babble Bots takeover, beatbox stack]
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — brandon tuned it tight
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — brandon tuned it tight
bwwwmmm-bwwm — brandon tuned it tight

[Final Drop - all layered]
Brandon tuned it tight — ajustado bem firme
Brandon tuned it tight — réglé à la perfection
Brandon tuned it tight — no machine, just connection
Three thirty six — the engineer's intention

[Outro - beatbox fade]
doom... doom... tss... tss...
Brandon... tuned... it... tight...
